# National League of Cities

> The National League of Cities (NLC) is a membership organization representing 2,675+ cities that advocates for municipal interests, provides professional development, and strengthens local government leadership.

NLC serves as the primary advocacy voice for American cities in Washington, D.C., offering membership benefits including networking through MyNLC, professional training via NLC University, and major convenings like the City Summit. The organization focuses on critical urban policy areas including housing, economic development, equity, and federal-local government relations.

## Membership & Organization

- [About - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/about): NLC organizational overview with 2,675+ member cities and leadership team
- [Membership Essentials - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/membership): NLC membership benefits including MyNLC, University, and City Summit access
- [Join NLC - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/membership/join): NLC membership enrollment for cities, towns, and villages nationwide
- [National League of Cities - A Century of Strengthening Cities](https://www.nlc.org): NLC homepage showcasing City Summit, leadership, and civic engagement initiatives

## Federal Advocacy & Policy

- [Advocacy Center - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/advocacy): Federal advocacy hub amplifying municipal voices in Washington, D.C.
- [Federal Advocacy Committees - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/advocacy/federal-advocacy-committees): Seven Federal Advocacy Committees driving NLC policy development efforts

## Professional Development & Training

- [NLC University - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/resources-training/nlc-university): NLC University online and live courses for municipal leadership development
- [Resources & Training - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/resources-training): NLC articles, training materials on housing, equity, and governance topics
- [Resource Library - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/resources-training/resource-library): Searchable library of NLC case studies, reports, and municipal guidance
- [Case Study - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/resources/type/case-study): NLC case studies on municipal programs for fines, violence, and employment

## Events & Conferences

- [Conferences & Meetings - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/conferences-meetings): NLC events including City Summit and Congressional City Conference

## News, Insights & Community

- [News & Insights - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/news-insights): CitiesSpeak news, resources, and how-tos for local government leaders
- [CitiesSpeak - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/citiesspeak): CitiesSpeak blog covering housing, economic development, and city policy
- [CitiesSpeak Podcast - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/news-insights/citiesspeak-podcast): CitiesSpeak podcast with Clarence Anthony on critical local leadership issues
- [3 Things to Know: A Monthly Video Series - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/3-things-to-know-a-monthly-video-series): Monthly video series highlighting NLC resources and city leadership topics
- [Newsletters - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/news-insights/newsletters): NLC newsletter subscriptions for city leaders on policy and governance topics
- [Press Room - National League of Cities](https://www.nlc.org/press-room): NLC press releases, media contacts, and news coverage information

## Member Services & Platforms

- [Home - National League of Cities](https://connectedcommunity.nlc.org): NLC Connected Community platform for member networking and resource sharing
- [NLC RISC - Risk Information Sharing Consortium](https://risc.nlc.org): Risk Information Sharing Consortium for municipal risk pooling and expertise
